dynamic_diagnostics.scope: Static background is reconstructed exactly from supplied data; its modulation outside Q is omitted and audited. Residual is a source-density diagnostic, not a scattering-error bound.

represented_dynamic_energy_balance.scope: Finite represented modulation current, including its interference with incident fields; not an assertion of unitary Floquet scattering or a full unprojected-material energy certificate.

weighted_conversion_reciprocity.normalization: Divide each output harmonic row by its native kappa_l
weighted_conversion_reciprocity.derivation: T_l,x=i*kappa_l*b_l.T/4; R_l.T=R_l and the phase-zero cosine material block M.T=M imply M@(I-R@M)^-1 is transpose symmetric. Therefore S_x[l,m]/kappa_l=(S_x[m,l]/kappa_m).T.
weighted_conversion_reciprocity.scope: Auxiliary control for this real globally phased cosine at Gamma; not imposed or generalized to traveling/phase-patterned modulation. Static R/T sampling residuals remain relevant.

old_small_singular_direction_removal_con.scope: Diagnostic only; this subset misses the predeclared five-frequency static material-source tolerance and does not replace the full dataset.

scopes: The complete matrix is complete only in this finite +/-2 window and the retained rank17 basis.
M1/M2 comparison applies to carrier input; outer-frequency input columns have no exterior harmonic convergence certificate.
Real-frequency forced scattering does not establish pole locations, causal stability, topology or a full QNM basis.
Periodic modulation uses independently initialized native material maps at 16 phases, including DC and +/-1..4 Fourier contrast; the derivative-only model is a separate control.
Source-density residual is not a scattering-error upper bound; native mesh sensitivity remains independent.
material_phase_8_nyquist_convention: The real even p=4 Nyquist coefficient is split equally between +/-4 in the N8 cosine interpolant.

raw_diagnostics.scope: Static background is reconstructed exactly from supplied data; its modulation outside Q is omitted and audited. Residual is a source-density diagnostic, not a scattering-error bound.
